claims.claim: The PWA itinerary content is synchronized to the 14-page v4 PDF covering Day 0-Day 5
claims.note: All pages were rendered to PNG and visually inspected; operational claims remain conditional until their stated recheck window.

claims.claim: Daily maps are rendered in-page with Leaflet and public OpenStreetMap tiles, with numbered stops, planned route lines and external Google Maps handoff links
claims.note: Solid lines indicate driving sequence; dashed lines indicate walking or transfer direction. The map is not live road geometry or live traffic routing. No Google Maps API key is stored or loaded.

claims.claim: Route-stop coordinates were rechecked against public OSM/Nominatim or OSM feature anchors and written into the static itinerary data
claims.queryMethod: Nominatim search plus Overpass OSM feature lookup; no runtime geocoding
